S1.name: Start MCP server + initialize
S1.note: Server starts, responds with protocolVersion 2024-11-05, serverInfo name 'Limitless MCP Server' version '0.0.1'

S2.name: List tools
S2.note: 30 tools listed with descriptions and JSON Schema input schemas. Covers auth (5), discovery (8), portfolio (7), trading (4), public (3), utility (3)

S3.name: Auth flow
S3.note: GET_SIGNING_MESSAGE returns nonce, signed with viem privateKeyToAccount().signMessage(), LOGIN succeeds, VERIFY_AUTH confirms session. Rate-limited (429) on repeated attempts within minutes.

S4.name: Balance/portfolio tool
S4.note: GET_PORTFOLIO_POSITIONS returns empty (valid), GET_USER_TRADED_VOLUME returns 0, GET_TRADING_ALLOWANCE returns allowance=0 with spender address

D1.name: GET_ACTIVE_MARKETS
D1.note: 967 active markets. sortBy accepts: ending_soon, high_value, lp_rewards, newest, trending. Pagination works.

D2.name: GET_MARKET by slug
D2.note: Returns question, slug, category, description, type (single/group), status, volume, end date, URL

D3.name: GET_MARKET_ORDERBOOK
D3.note: Returns last trade price, adjusted midpoint, max spread, min size, asks (price|size), bids (price|size), totals. Works for single-type markets.

D4.name: SEARCH_MARKETS
D4.note: Semantic search with configurable limit, page, similarityThreshold. Returns slug, volume, URL per result.

D5.name: Query 3 different markets
D5.note: Consistent response structure across bitcoin-price-on-june-30, solana-price-on-june-30, bitcoin-all-time-high-by markets

T1.name: Preview order
T1.note: BLOCKED. No preview/estimate tool exists. Orderbook provides raw bid/ask but no trade simulation.

T2.name: Place order + verify
T2.note: BLOCKED. CREATE_ORDER requires fully pre-signed EIP-712 typed data order. No signing abstraction. Client must know domain separator, type hashes, construct order struct in wei, sign typed data. Schema bug: side documented as enum ['BUY','SELL'] but API expects number.

T3.name: Cancel order + verify
T3.note: BLOCKED. CANCEL_ORDER tool exists with simple orderId param (good abstraction) but cannot test without a placed order.

T4.name: Market buy + position
T4.note: BLOCKED. Same as T2 - no order construction abstraction.

T5.name: Sell + balance delta
T5.note: BLOCKED. Same as T2 - no order construction abstraction.

E1.name: Oversized/bad order
E1.note: Returns structured 400 error with field-level validation messages. Helpful error text includes suggestion to check balance/allowance.

E2.name: Invalid inputs
E2.note: JSON-RPC error -32602 with field-level validation (e.g., 'String must contain at least 1 character(s)'). Clean parameter validation before API call.

E3.name: Query resolved/closed market
E3.note: Resolved markets return 404 'Market not found'. No way to distinguish 'never existed' from 'resolved'. Limitless removes resolved markets from API.

E4.name: Bad input then valid call (recovery)
E4.note: Server recovers cleanly. 404 error followed by successful GET_ACTIVE_MARKETS call.

metadata.rateLimit: Aggressive - 429 on repeated login within minutes
metadata.apiTokenHint: 429 error suggests API token auth available at docs.limitless.exchange

keyFindings: Discovery is excellent: 30 tools covering markets, orderbook, history, search, categories, feed events
Auth works but is rate-limited aggressively (429 within minutes)
Trading is fundamentally BLOCKED: CREATE_ORDER requires fully pre-signed EIP-712 typed data - no signing abstraction
Schema inconsistency: CREATE_ORDER.side documented as enum ['BUY','SELL'] but API expects numeric value
Orderbook + historical price provide good data for analysis (price, spread, midpoint, volume)
CANCEL_ORDER has good abstraction (just orderId) but untestable without placed orders
Resolved markets disappear from API (404) with no resolution data accessible
Group-type markets (multi-outcome) don't work with orderbook/history - need sub-market slugs
Session auth persists within MCP connection but rate limits make reconnection painful

blockers.issue: No trading abstraction - CREATE_ORDER requires pre-signed EIP-712 typed data
blockers.detail: Client must independently know the Limitless CLOB contract's EIP-712 domain separator, type hashes, construct the order struct with correct tokenId/amounts in wei, track nonces, and sign the typed data. The MCP server acts as a passthrough, not an abstraction layer.
blockers.impact: An AI agent cannot trade without a separate EIP-712 signing library tightly coupled to Limitless contract specifics

blockers.detail: side field documented as enum ['BUY','SELL'] but API rejects strings, expects numeric value. No documentation on what numbers map to what sides.
blockers.impact: Even with EIP-712 signing capability, the tool's own schema is misleading

blockers.issue: Aggressive rate limiting on auth endpoint
blockers.detail: 429 Too Many Requests after single login within minutes. Error suggests using API tokens instead.
blockers.impact: Agent restarts or reconnections may fail auth. Need API token support.

blockers.issue: Resolved markets return 404 with no resolution data
blockers.detail: Cannot access historical resolution outcomes, only active markets visible
blockers.impact: Agent cannot learn from past market resolutions

comparisonToPriorTest.changes: No improvement in trading abstraction since prior test. Discovery remains strong (same finding). The fundamental blocker - requiring pre-signed EIP-712 orders with no abstraction - is unchanged. Grade remains C.
